To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the inclusion of sentiment analysis features in the response generation system marginally improves the quality of responses generated by the system.

the use of a sentiment analysis feature in a dialogue model improves the performance of a response generator, and that this model is capable of generating responses that are comparable to those of a human counselor.
the inclusion of sentiment analysis features into a dialogue system trained on counseling data improves the quality of generated responses.
In summary, our research is concerned with
improving the quality of a dialogue system by including sentiment analysis data in response generation.
improving the quality of responses generated by text-based conversational agents.
developing a chatbot that provides emotional support for suicidal thoughts.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed model is able to generate responses with sentiment analysis features and it is able to generate better responses than the baseline model.

our work is the first to explore the use of sentiment analysis data for end-to-end dialogue systems and the first to explore sentiment analysis data in the context of a dialogue system for psychiatric assistance.
we have successfully implemented a chatbot that can be used as a tool to assist people with suicidal thoughts.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
our model can be used for a chatbot that provides a temporary channel for suicidal people to express their thoughts and feelings, while they are waiting for the professional help.

the inclusion of sentiment analysis features improves response quality, but does not improve response quality enough to justify the additional cost and complexity of training and maintaining the sentiment analysis model.
our approach can be used as a first step for people who are experiencing suicidal thoughts.
The main takeaway from our work is that
sentiment analysis data can be used to improve the quality of text responses generated by an AI conversational agent, especially when the input is a user’s text message.
sentiment analysis can be used to improve dialogue systems in certain applications.
sentiment analysis data, when used in combination with a large corpus of counseling transcripts, is a promising direction for future research into end-to-end, text-based dialogue agents.
